change_package.title: v3.1.0 release — add user notification preferences API
change_package.diff_text:
--- a/src/notifications/views.py
+++ b/src/notifications/views.py
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+class NotificationPreferencesView(APIView):
+    def get(self, request, user_id):
+        prefs = NotificationPreference.objects.get(user_id=user_id)
+        return Response(PreferenceSerializer(prefs).data)
+
+    def put(self, request, user_id):
+        prefs, _ = NotificationPreference.objects.get_or_create(user_id=user_id)
+        serializer = PreferenceSerializer(prefs, data=request.data, partial=True)
+        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
+        serializer.save()
+        return Response(serializer.data)
change_package.author_summary: Adds the notification preferences CRUD API. New endpoint: GET/PUT /api/users/{id}/notification-preferences. DB migration adds the notification_preferences table.
change_package.rollback_plan: Run migration 0055 down. Revert deployment. No data loss — table is new.
